starts.title: Two branches
starts.banner: Try: git switch bright-lights, then pick another view.

starts.title: Alex is ahead
starts.blurb: Alex pushed two commits you have not fetched.
starts.banner: Alex sent two commits. Try: git status, then git fetch.

starts.title: Both committed
starts.blurb: You and Alex each committed a different file: a merge with no conflict.
starts.banner: You and Alex each made a commit. Try: git status, then git pull --no-rebase.

starts.title: Conflict
